title: Radical Ventures: AI neolabs, many lacking products, markets, or revenue, raised $24B in the past two quarters, nearly 5x OpenAI and Anthropic pre-ChatGPT (Louise Lucas/Financial Times)
commentary: $24B into AI shops with no product, no market, no revenue — in two quarters. The pre-ChatGPT benchmark is doing a lot of work here: we're funding the next wave at 5x the price before we've seen if the last wave worked.
